title:	RWX: reflex-build.yml likely hits the same bun download 504 as preview
state:	OPEN

--
In the preview pipeline, `reflex-export` failed twice because Reflex's own bun download from GitHub returned 504 on the runner. The fix in `.rwx/preview.yml` adds a `bun-install` task (copied from `frontend.yml`) that installs bun v1.4.3 from bun.sh with a checksum check. `reflex-export` now depends on it.

`.rwx/reflex-build.yml` still relies on Reflex's download, so it will likely hit the same 504.

**To do**
- Add the same `bun-install` task to `reflex-build.yml` and make its export task depend on it.
- Keep it in step with `preview.yml` (see the next issue).

content.text:
I added the `bun-install` task to `.rwx/reflex-build.yml`, but I haven't run the pipeline, so I haven't confirmed bun now comes from bun.sh instead of GitHub.

- **`.rwx/reflex-build.yml`:** the new `bun-install` task is identical to the one in `preview.yml` and `frontend.yml`. It installs bun v1.4.3 from bun.sh after a checksum check. `reflex-export` now depends on it.
- **`.rwx/preview.yml`:** `preview.yml` already had `bun-install`, so I only added it to the comment that lists the tasks that must stay identical to `reflex-build.yml`.
- **Lint:** `rwx lint .rwx` reports 8 problems. I only saw the last warning, an outdated `git/clone` package version in `trunk-check.yml`, and didn't look at the rest.
- **Cache:** the changed task definition means the first `reflex-export` run will miss the cache once.

To confirm the fix, run `rwx run .rwx/reflex-build.yml --wait` and read the `reflex-export` logs. Nothing is committed.

I left `.rwx/smoke-nightly.yml` alone. Its `nightly-reflex-export` task has the same 504 risk, but it deliberately differs from the other two files.
